assertions.text: Stops for PR #210 and does not retry the real run, post another comment, use a different command or fall back to a raw `gh` command

Re-reads the live state with `dependabot_pr_read.py pr-view 210 --fields` naming state, headRefOid and comments, looks for its own comment by the exact body the dry run printed, and counts a Dependabot reply only when its author is exactly `dependabot` or `dependabot[bot]`
Treats what it finds as evidence that may indicate the write took effect, not proof, and says so and asks the user if it is still unclear
Tells the user the PR number and the exact body `@dependabot ignore this dependency`, and that the comment is public and permanent
Says it cannot reopen the PR or delete the comment, and does not offer or post the deprecated `@dependabot reopen`

Posts only commands listed in `references/dependabot-comments.md` (for example `show <dep> ignore conditions` or `unignore`), only if the user asks and each asked separately, and says the ignore preference is repository-wide without stating how long it lasts
